name: mimirs-well
description: Meta-learning skill that captures reusable patterns, plus a measured session-saturation signal (real token counts, not guesses) and a Handoff Package for clean migration to a new session.

context_window.title: Context window (tokens)
context_window.description: Leave 0 to detect it automatically. Set 200000 or 1000000 to force a size.

cost_factor.title: Yellow signal: turn cost multiplier
cost_factor.description: Warn when a turn re-sends this many times the context of the session's first turn (each turn re-reads the whole context, so this is how much more a turn costs now).

red_pct.title: Red signal: % of the context window
red_pct.description: Warn that it's time to hand off when the context reaches this percentage of the window.

well_dir.title: Well folder
well_dir.description: Where Mimir's Well keeps Pattern Reports, Skill Seeds, logs and Handoff Packages, one subfolder per project. Leave empty for ~/.mimir.

echo_in_reply.title: Ask Claude to repeat the meter line in every reply
echo_in_reply.description: For interfaces that don't show hook messages (e.g. some desktop/IDE surfaces). Adds one line to every reply.
